lines: The world is about to announce its end
No one can stop it anymore
———It begins
A symphony of collapse rings out
The falling rain sounds like tears
Tell me
People who rule and are ruled
will someday fill their hearts with hatred
and forget how to love
Is that why they fight?
You can hear this song
All beings with life
The truth lies within your heart
Even when crossing a storm-tossed sea
It gives you a strength
that never knows fear
But the farther you go, the stronger the wind
And the light of hope soon fades away
"Give me the light"—they fight over it
And in the end, people kill each other
Their tears long since dried up
Realize it
Those eyes were made to see one another
That voice was made to convey longing
Those hands were made to join with the ones you hold dear
You can hear this song
All the lost souls of the world, with nowhere to turn
Hope lies within your heart
Even in the midst of raging flames
It gives you a strength
that can never be wounded
The things you tried to protect with those hands
Were they the ones you loved?
Gazing at your hands, dyed crimson
You finally admit the foolishness you have committed
The sin of acknowledging your mistake
And you know those tears, overflowing without end
You can hear this song
All beings with life
The truth lies within your heart
The storm-tossed sea has gone still
Though what was lost is beyond counting
You can hear this song
All the lost souls of the world, with nowhere to turn
Hope lies within your heart
When you cross the night of sorrow
You will surely find you have the strength
to go on living
